tickets.title: US003: Daily Special Push Notifications
tickets.description:
As a Student who has opted into marketing alerts, I want to receive a push notification at 11:30 AM regarding the daily lunch special, so that I can take advantage of cafeteria discounts.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. Pass/Fail: A scheduled push notification is sent successfully to opted-in devices exactly at 11:30 AM local time.
2. Pass/Fail: Tapping the notification opens the app directly to the discounted daily special item.
